dedupe_keys.name: high resolution modeling of river floodplain reservoir inundation dynamics in the mekong river basin

description: High Resolution Modeling of River-floodplain-reservoir Inundation Dynamics in the Mekong River Basin is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Shin, Sanghoon (deposited on HydroShare). Numerous studies have examined the changes in streamflow in the Mekong River Basin (MRB) using observations and hydrological modeling; however, there is a lack of integrated modeling studies that explicitly simulate the natural and human‐induced changes in flood dynamics over the entire basin. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2019-09-30 and last updated 2020-05-22; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
